$comment: Ten 'packet copilot' use cases used to prove this SDK can deploy and drive GitHub Copilot harness agents with knowledge, tools (MCP, connector, agent flow), skills and connected agents. Each becomes a parent agent + a child data agent. Generated workspaces live next to this file.

workflowTool.name: SiteWeather
workflowTool.description: Agent flow that returns the weather forecast for a location. Use only when the user asks about weather at a site, store, facility, or route. Requires a location.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City, region, postal code, or place name.

inputs.name: forecast_days
inputs.description: Forecast days from 1 through 10. Defaults to 3.

environmentMcp.name: EnvironmentData
environmentMcp.description: Dataverse MCP server for the environment. Use only when the user explicitly asks to look up or list records in Dataverse tables. Never create, update or delete records.

usecases.name: Vendor Contract Renewal Copilot
usecases.reviews: the legal approval packet, checks required clauses, reconciles terms across amendments
usecases.recordA: vendor Acme Logistics, effective 2023-10-01, expires 2026-09-30, pricing $18.50/unit with tiered discount at 10k+ units/month, SLA 99.5% on-time delivery and 48h defect response, 36-month term, no auto-renew, signatories J. Alvarez (Acme CFO) and M. Chen (Buyer VP Procurement), riders: Data Processing Addendum v2, Insurance Certificate 2023
usecases.recordB: vendor Acme Logistics, effective 2026-10-01, expires 2029-09-30, pricing $21.75/unit with tiered discount at 15k+ units/month, SLA 99.0% on-time delivery and 72h defect response, 36-month term, auto-renew ON, signatories J. Alvarez (Acme CFO) only, riders: Data Processing Addendum v3, Insurance Certificate 2023

knowledge.name: FederalAcquisitionRegulation
knowledge.description: Public FAR text on acquisition.gov. Search it for required contract clauses, option-period and renewal rules, and termination language.

domainMcp.name: CiteRenewalClauses
domainMcp.description: Returns renewal, pricing, SLA and termination clauses for an agreement with citations. Use when the user asks which clauses apply or wants clause text quoted.

proofExpect.knowledgeQuestion: Which clauses does the Federal Acquisition Regulation require for contract option periods and renewals? Say which knowledge source you used.

usecases.name: Claims Intake Reconciliation Copilot
usecases.compare: submitted claim forms against policy coverage
usecases.recordA: claim CLM-88213, claimant R. Patel, loss type water damage, date of loss 2026-08-14, reported 2026-08-20, claimed amount $14,200, attachments: photos (6), plumber invoice, police report MISSING, proof of ownership MISSING, fraud flag: prior claim within 12 months
usecases.recordB: policy POL-55021, holder R. Patel, coverage water damage up to $25,000, deductible $1,000, exclusions: gradual seepage, flood; requires police report for theft only, proof of ownership for items over $2,500; effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31

knowledge.name: NaicConsumerGuidance
knowledge.description: Public NAIC guidance on claims handling, documentation standards, and consumer protections. Search it for claim documentation and fair claims practice rules.

domainMcp.name: VerifyInsurance
domainMcp.description: Verifies insurance coverage details for a member or policy. Use when the user asks to verify coverage or eligibility for a claim.

proofExpect.knowledgeQuestion: What does NAIC guidance say about documentation an insurer may require to process a claim? Say which knowledge source you used.

knowledge.name: NrfRetailResources
knowledge.description: Public National Retail Federation resources on store operations and merchandising practice. Search it for reset and compliance practices.

usecases.name: Clinical Trial Site Activation Copilot

usecases.recordB: protocol PROTO-4471 v4, indication moderate asthma, inclusion age 18-75 and FEV1 55-85%, exclusion smokers in last 12 months, dosing 200mcg twice daily for 16 weeks, IRB approval PENDING, site documents: 1572 signed, CV on file, IRB letter MISSING, informed consent v4 MISSING

knowledge.name: FdaRegulatoryInformation
knowledge.description: Public FDA regulatory information including clinical trial and IRB requirements. Search it for informed consent and IRB documentation rules.

domainMcp.name: LogComplianceAudit
domainMcp.description: Records or lists compliance audit entries for clinical documentation. Use when the user asks to log or review a compliance audit entry.

usecases.recordB: loan LN-204118-MOD1, borrower T. Nguyen, modified principal $318,400 (capitalized arrears), rate 5.50% fixed, term 480 months, escrow $530/month, disclosures on file: TILA, RESPA servicing; modification agreement UNSIGNED, updated escrow analysis MISSING

knowledge.name: CfpbMortgageServicing
knowledge.description: Public CFPB rules and guidance on mortgage servicing, loss mitigation and required borrower disclosures. Search it for servicing and modification rules.

domainMcp.name: EnrichAffordabilityData
domainMcp.description: Returns affordability data for a borrower. Use when the user asks whether a borrower can afford modified terms.

proofExpect.knowledgeQuestion: What does the CFPB require a servicer to do when a borrower requests loss mitigation? Say which knowledge source you used.

usecases.name: Supplier Onboarding Compliance Copilot
usecases.compare: supplier submissions against required certifications (insurance, ESG, tax)
usecases.recordA: supplier submission SUP-NORTHWIND-2026, Northwind Fasteners, W-9 received 2026-08-02, certificate of insurance $1M general liability expires 2026-11-30, ESG questionnaire MISSING, ISO 9001 certificate received, bank letter received, DUNS 08-123-4567
